remarks: Rare Rental Opportunity in the Heart of Old Greenwich's Waterside Community! Discover this beautifully renovated home, ideally located just moments from the vibrant Old Greenwich village restaurants, top-rated schools, beach, park and train station. This unique property offers 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 bathrooms with modern and tasteful finishes and details. The house features a bright, open-concept living space centered around a cozy fireplace, perfect for chilly winter evenings. In the warmer months, step out to the new patio complete with outdoor grilling, a fireplace and TV, perfect for entertaining or relaxing.
